data.title: Coca-Cola Names David Elkins as New Chief Financial Officer
data.description:
Coca-Cola ( (KO) ) has provided an update.

On November 23, 2026, Coca-Cola announced that David V. Elkins would succeed John Murphy as executive vice president and chief financial officer, effective April 2, 2027. Murphy would continue serving as president, while Elkins would oversee finance, global strategy and Enterprise Services.

Elkins had served as Bristol Myers Squibb’s CFO since 2019 and previously held senior finance roles at Celgene, Johnson & Johnson, Becton, Dickinson and AstraZeneca. Coca-Cola also disclosed that Elkins’ compensation would include a $1,180,000 base salary and a target annual incentive equal to 135% of base salary.

data.title: Future FinTech Group Amends Articles, Expands Authorized Shares
data.description:
Future FinTech Group ( (FTFT) ) just unveiled an update.

On November 19, 2026, Future FinTech Group held its annual meeting, where shareholders elected five directors, ratified Wei, Wei & Co., LLP as the independent registered public accounting firm for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026, and approved the 2026 Omnibus Equity Plan. Holders of 5,838,337.66 shares, representing approximately 67.303% of the 8,674,730 shares outstanding and entitled to vote, were present in person or by proxy, constituting a quorum.

On November 23, 2026, the company filed amendments that became effective upon filing, increasing authorized common shares from 9,375,000 to 900,000,000 while leaving 10,000,000 authorized preferred shares unchanged. The amendments also changed the approval requirements for future amendments to the Articles of Incorporation, requiring board approval and the affirmative vote of a majority of votes cast by eligible voting shareholders, subject to applicable law and preferred-stock designations.

data.title: Longeveron Appoints Paul Lehr as Chief Executive Officer
data.description:
Longeveron ( (LGVN) ) just unveiled an announcement.

On November 17, 2026, Longeveron commenced a second round of employee notifications involving a strategic workforce reduction, bringing total separations under the Board’s directive to 15 employees, or approximately 60% of the then-existing workforce, including CEO Stephen Willard and CTO and Senior Vice President of Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls Devin Blass. The action followed the Board’s direction to review strategic options for maximizing stockholder value and implement cash-conservation measures.

On November 20, 2026, Willard stepped down immediately as CEO and a Board member, and the Board appointed General Counsel and Corporate Secretary Paul Lehr as CEO, effective immediately. Lehr joined the company in 2016 and continued serving as Corporate Secretary.

data.title: Vale Announces Partial Resumption of Viga Mine Operations
data.description:

data.title: Frontier Nuclear Receives Nasdaq Notice Over Delayed Annual Filing
data.description:
Frontier Nuclear and Minerals ( (FNUC) ) has shared an update.

Frontier Nuclear and Minerals Inc. is a nuclear fuel cycle company focused on building a U.S.-based nuclear fuel cycle platform through uranium exploration and development assets, plus targeted investments in Ubaryon Pty. Ltd., which is developing enrichment technology, and Kadmos Energy Services LLC, which is developing small modular light water reactors.

On November 18, 2026, Nasdaq notified Frontier that it was not compliant with Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) because it had not timely filed its annual report for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, with the SEC. The notice had no immediate effect on Frontier’s listing or trading, but Nasdaq gave the company until January 18, 2027, to submit a compliance plan and said it would be added to its public list of non-compliant companies.

data.title: Tuya Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Results, Declares Cash Dividend
data.description:
The latest update is out from Tuya ( (TUYA) ).

Tuya Inc. is a global AI cloud platform service provider whose offerings include platform-as-a-service, AI applications and other services, and smart home and robot products.

On Nov. 23, 2026, Tuya reported unaudited third-quarter results for the period ended Sept. 30, 2026, with revenue of US$98.6 million, up 19.5% year over year, and net profit of US$18.5 million. PaaS revenue rose 18.3% to US$70.1 million, while the company declared a cash dividend.

Operating margin increased to 9.0% from 4.6%, although gross margin fell to 45.8% from 48.3%; operating cash generation was US$12.7 million. Premium PaaS customers reached 331 and registered AI developers exceeded 2.18 million, while AI-native category shipments grew more than 400% year over year, according to the company.

data.title: XMAX Enters Corporate Guarantee Agreement for DSH Obligations
data.description:
XMAX ( (XMAX) ) has provided an announcement.

On November 17, 2026, XMax Inc. entered into a corporate guarantee agreement with KT and DSH for KT’s benefit, following approval by XMax’s board. The guarantee covered certain unpaid DSH obligations under the upstream agreement, including eligible monthly charges, specified termination penalties and related costs, with principal recovery limited to KRW 155,012,298,700, approximately US$117 million, plus applicable interest and taxes.

The guarantee excluded DSH liabilities unrelated to qualifying XMax defaults and required payment within 30 days of a complying demand after seven days of nonpayment. It terminates 12 months after expiry or termination of the upstream agreement, except for conforming demands made before that date.

data.title: Ready Capital Announces One-for-Ten Reverse Stock Split
data.description:
Ready Capital ( (RC) ) has shared an update.

Ready Capital, a multi-strategy real estate finance company, announced on November 23, 2026, that its Board of Directors had approved a one-for-ten reverse stock split without stockholder approval. Scheduled to take effect at 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time on December 7, the split will reduce approximately 159.1 million outstanding common shares to approximately 15.9 million and authorized shares from 500 million to 50 million.

The reverse split will apply uniformly and will not affect stockholders’ ownership percentages, apart from de minimis changes from cash payments for fractional shares. Conversion and change-of-control provisions for the Series C and Series E preferred stock will be adjusted proportionately, while their outstanding share counts, liquidation preferences and dividend rates will remain unchanged.

data.title: ICZOOM Group Receives Additional Nasdaq Notice Over Delinquent Annual Report
data.description:
ICZOOM Group, Inc. Class A ( (IZM) ) has provided an announcement.

ICZOOM Group Inc. operates a B2B e-commerce platform selling electronic components primarily to customers in Hong Kong and mainland China. Its customers are China-based SMEs in consumer electronics, IoT, automotive electronics and industry control, and it also provides temporary warehousing, logistics and shipping, and customs-clearance services.

On November 20, 2026, ICZOOM received an additional written Nasdaq notification that it was out of compliance with Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) because its Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, remained unfiled. The notice had no immediate effect on the listing or trading of the company’s securities.

The company was required to submit an updated compliance plan by December 7, 2026, while Nasdaq said any additional exception for regaining compliance with delinquent filings would be limited to a maximum of 180 calendar days from the interim report’s due date, December 28, 2026. If compliance is not restored by then, Nasdaq may issue a delisting determination, and the company could request a hearing.
